QuestInfo.name: X Month X Day in Pantheon
QuestInfo.0: See what kind of business transaction the #bPapyrus Brothers#k have in mind.
QuestInfo.1: You'll learn about your next mission in the #bEast Pantheon Secret Meet-Up Spot#k, which is somewhere along the #bEast Pantheon Border#k.
QuestInfo.2: Looks like you beat the trading partner to the East Pantheon Secret Meet-Up Spot.

0.msg: You're here about Mr. Hazard's secret account, right?\r\n

1.msg: Since our branch took him down, we're splitting his business between all the branch members.\r\n

2.msg: And you got a good one. Your drop-off point is the #bEast Pantheon Secret Meet-Up Spot#k. You up to this?\r\n

0.msg: Here are the goods. The money should already be there. Take the dough, leave the goods, and get back here.\r\n

1.msg: Keep your eyes open. I never trust a client who won't show his face... But I'm sure you can handle it.\r\n
